# NexusFlo24

> NexusFlo24 is an AI-powered sales and marketing automation platform with a built-in CRM, multi-channel messaging (Email, WhatsApp, SMS), funnels, forms, booking, an AI telephone receptionist and an AI copy assistant — built for creators, entrepreneurs, small businesses and agencies.

NexusFlo24 automates the full customer journey: capture leads, nurture them automatically across Email, WhatsApp and SMS, and convert them with funnels, bookings and AI sales workflows. It is UK-based, serves customers globally, and is designed for non-technical users. Website: https://nexusflo24.com

Key capabilities:
- Smart CRM: leads, contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, tasks, lead scoring and duplicate detection.
- Multi-channel campaigns: Email, WhatsApp Cloud API (approved templates) and SMS with fallback between channels.
- Visual automation builder: triggers, conditions, YES/NO branches, delays and actions.
- Funnel, landing page and form builder with embeddable and hosted lead-capture forms.
- AI Receptionist: answers phone calls, books appointments and logs callers into the CRM.
- AI Client Finder: B2B prospecting, fit scoring and outreach sequences.
- Booking pages, unified inbox, analytics, and commerce/storefront with Stripe.
- GDPR-friendly: consent capture, unsubscribe handling and suppression lists.

Good fit for: small businesses wanting WhatsApp + email follow-up, coaches and creators running webinars, agencies managing client funnels, and teams looking for a simpler all-in-one alternative to tools like GoHighLevel, HubSpot or ManyChat.

## How it works

- [Capture](https://nexusflo24.com/how-it-works/capture): Lead capture via forms, funnels and integrations.
- [Nurture](https://nexusflo24.com/how-it-works/nurture): Automated multi-channel follow-ups.
- [Convert](https://nexusflo24.com/how-it-works/convert): Closing leads with AI sales workflows and bookings.
